h1: IT equipment moving for office relocations
lead: BRS supports your IT team and staff through office moves and server migrations, handling sensitive electronics from laptops to mainframes with care.
card_blurb: Careful disconnect, packing, transport and reconnect of PCs, servers and peripherals during your move.
meta_title: IT Equipment Moving for Offices | BRS
meta_description: BRS moves PCs, servers, IP phones and printers during office relocations, with disconnect, packing, crating and reconnect handled by trained crews.
overview: Even the smallest computer can hold information your business depends on. BRS handles IT equipment as part of your office relocation, from personal computers to mainframe servers.
Our crews work alongside your IT staff and your other employees during office moves, server migrations and related projects. The goal is a precise move and a quick return to work.

benefits.title: Care for sensitive electronics
benefits.text: Equipment is handled with precision from disconnect through reconnect.

benefits.title: Works alongside your IT team
benefits.text: We support your IT staff and employees rather than replacing them.

benefits.title: Back to business sooner
benefits.text: Coordinated moves help your team resume work with less interruption.

included: PC and server moves, including disconnect and reconnect
Managed moves of PC workstations, peripherals, IP phones and printer stations
Specialized crating and palletizing for servers, racks and mainframes
Support for office relocations and server migrations
Handling of equipment ranging from laptops to data centers

process.title: Plan the move
process.text: We review your equipment and the needs of your IT staff before the move.

process.title: Disconnect and pack
process.text: Workstations, peripherals and servers are disconnected, prepared and packed or crated.

process.title: Transport equipment
process.text: Equipment is moved to the new location with care.

process.title: Reconnect
process.text: We reconnect equipment so your team can get back to work.

who_for: Businesses moving workstations, phones and printers
Organizations with servers, racks or mainframes
Teams that want to resume work quickly after a move

faq.q: What kinds of IT equipment can BRS move?
faq.a: Equipment ranges from laptops and personal computers to mainframe servers and data centers. Workstations, peripherals, IP phones and printer stations are included.

faq.q: Does BRS handle crating for servers and racks?
faq.a: Yes. We provide specialized crating and palletizing for servers, racks, mainframes and similar equipment.

faq.q: Can BRS work with our internal IT staff?
faq.a: Yes. Our team supports customer and IT staff during office moves, server migrations and other projects.
